preconditions: Borehole and DEM coordinates use the same horizontal CRS
DEM sample is hash-bound to its source raster tile
Vertical reference compatibility is declared or unresolved explicitly

variables.z_dem: DEM terrain elevation at the borehole coordinate, metres

decisionLogic: Report comparison class against a declared diagnostic threshold; never convert agreement into survey-accuracy verification
uncertainty: DEM resolution, vegetation/surface representation, coordinate reading error and collar-survey accuracy remain separate and may be unknown
exclusions: Not proof of collar levelling accuracy
Not geological correlation or section authorization
validationMethod: positive, threshold-boundary, hash-tamper, CRS/datum mismatch and non-finite tests
reopenCondition: A provider survey report, benchmark tie, vertical transformation or source-specific DEM uncertainty model becomes available
